text: Cycling demands precise control, and one of the most crucial aspects of maintaining this control involves the effective operation of brakes. Whether you're riding a road bike, a mountain bike, or a hybrid, ensuring your brakes are in top condition is a fundamental safety measure. Regular inspections of brake pads and rotors can prevent unnecessary stops and prolong the lifespan of your braking system. Additionally, tire inspection before each ride is equally important. Checking for any cuts, cracks, or signs of wear can prevent unexpected punctures and ensure your safety on the road. Keeping both brakes and tires in good condition not only enhances your riding experience but also contributes to your overall safety, making cycling not just an enjoyable activity but a smart and prepared one as well.
